methods.description: Rewrite touching signs first. Start at the first integer, then move right to add a positive integer or left to subtract one.
For two negative integers, add the magnitudes and keep the minus sign. For opposite directions, split the larger magnitude to make a zero pair.
Rewrite touching signs and evaluate successive additions and subtractions from left to right.
